invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Stream (Stream instances can be empty but not null, unless explicitly returned as null, which is not the case here).
Parallelism is used by the engine to control parallel processing and should be positive for meaningful computation.
The input stream is expected to be non-null to perform operations; a null input would likely cause an exception before method exit.
flatMapToPairFunc is dereferenced and passed to wrappers, so it must be non-null.
reduceFunc is wrapped and used in a reduce operation, so it must be non-null by method exit.
